footer.tagline: India's intelligent property matchmaking platform. Discover flats, villas, plots, and commercial offices across prime Indian cities.
footer.disclaimerText: BrokersBlitz is solely an intermediary platform connecting buyers and brokers. All listing details and RERA numbers are provided directly by third parties and are not independently verified. Users are strongly advised to independently verify all property titles, sanctions, and official RERA registrations on state government portals before executing agreements or making any financial commitments.
